Title: Retirement: Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 2.4 Disablement

Body.Content:
Disablement for Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 2.4 was announced on August 15th, 2024. We recommend that you upgrade your Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 2.4 workloads to Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.4 - Azure Synapse Analytics | Microsoft Learn otherwise your jobs will stop executing.

Learn more.
